Container.Name: half-life-wasm
Container.Overview: Half-Life (GoldSource) running in the browser via Xash3D-FWGS compiled to WebAssembly. Single-player; closing the tab is the only quit. Requires your own Half-Life data files (valve/owner-valve.pk3) mounted at /data.
Container.Requires: You must supply your own legally-owned Half-Life game data. Place valve-owner.pk3 and valve-liblist.gam under the Game Data path in a goldsource/ subfolder.

Config.Name: Game Data
Config.Description: Container Path: /data — holds goldsource/ with the owner .pk3 archives
